title: R2VC：模块化事实核查的检索、验证与置信度校准架构
summary: R2VC提出模块化事实核查架构，将检索、推理、验证与置信度校准解耦，结合混合稀疏+稠密检索、DPO对齐生成器、NLI交叉编码器筛选与序列级校准器。在FEVER上8B模型准确率提升13.74%，消融显示候选筛选与校准贡献最大，检索失败仍是主要瓶颈。
summary_en: R2VC presents a modular retrieve, reason, verify, calibrate architecture for evidence-grounded fact checking, combining hybrid sparse+dense retrieval over Wikipedia, a DPO-aligned generator, an NLI cross-encoder for candidate selection, and a sequence-level confidence calibrator with abstention. On FEVER, an 8B backbone achieves 13.74% higher accuracy than baseline; ablations show verifier-based selection and calibration are the largest contributors, while retrieval failures remain the dominant bottleneck.
